title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Stadium on 1986-12-16
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) ->
taper: Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for the Cassettes
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MX-XG90) D

ai_review.summary: Good matrix recording captures a solid 1986 show with standout Sugaree > Jack Straw segue and high‑energy Iko Iko.
ai_review.review: The tape, a roughly 75 % soundboard/25 % audience mix, sounds clear and well‑balanced, delivering an enjoyable listening experience. The performance is praised for its interesting set list – highlights include the Sugaree→Jack Straw transition, Box of Rain opening the second set, and a fast‑tempo Iko Iko – and for being one of the first shows after Jerry’s return from his coma. Overall fans describe it as a damn good show with great vibes.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments about both the musical performance and the sound quality; weighted rating (70 % show, 30 % recording) yields a high‑average score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as ~75 % SBD and 25 % ambient audience; reviewers note good sound, clear mix, no significant dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Interesting set list with a strong first‑set finish (Sugaree→Jack Straw) that carries into a solid second set opener (Box of Rain) and energetic moments like Willie and the Hand Jive → Iko Iko.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His return after the coma was celebrated; vocals/guitar praised, especially on ‘Stella Blue’ and other moments.
